title: Recent outcome glyphs follow the ASCII option; Waves overlap lines hang-indent
lead: TUI only (N-class): no file under `internal/engine`, `internal/daemon` or `cmd`.
findings_note: 2026-11-17: re-checked at f48a6154. With `cfg.ASCII` true the Overview Recent rows still print `✓ pass`, `✗ fail` and `✓ landed` (`internal/tui/relayboard.go:452-462`), while the gate verdict in the same pane switches to `x` (`internal/tui/runtree.go:404-407`). A Waves overlap line that wraps starts its second line at the column of `!` (probe at 80x24: `  ! A and B both touch` / `  testdata/golden/waves-sitting-held-80x24-mono.txt`), while the engine-conflict marker two lines above hangs its continuations four columns in (`internal/tui/waves.go:717-724`).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner decisions (2026-11-17): Recent outcomes in ASCII mode read `+ pass`, `x fail`, `+ landed` (adj 418); wrapped Waves overlap lines hang-indent like the engine-conflict marker (adj 419). The alert keeps `? owner questions N` (adj 420; not built). The text-field scroll cue moved to S227 (adj 444 supersedes 421; not in this slice).

S228 kept two S130 leftovers that the S130 sweep left out because they were not in its notes. Both are still in the code at f48a6154.

1. **Recent ignores the ASCII option** (S228, S130 "out of scope"). `recentRows` writes `✓ pass`, `✗ fail`, `✓ landed` and `✓ landed, cleanup failed` with no `cfg.ASCII` check (`internal/tui/relayboard.go:452-462`). Every other glyph the TUI draws has an ASCII form: rules (`th.rules(m.cfg.ASCII)`), the ready mark `·` -> `*` (`internal/tui/roadmap.go:370-375`), the sparkline (`internal/tui/overview.go:1823`), and the gate verdict `✗` -> `x` (`internal/tui/runtree.go:404-407`, pinned by `TestAsciiGateVerdictHasNoUnicode`, `internal/tui/runtree_test.go:739`). A probe at 80x24 with `cfg.ASCII` true draws the rule as `|` and the row as `|    ork  ✓ pass  S97  10m  ended 5m ago`. `rowLine` picks the outcome's colour from the `✓`/`✗` prefix (`internal/tui/overview.go:946-953`), so an ASCII glyph must keep that colour. Docs: `docs/dashboard.md:745-749`.
2. **Overlap lines do not hang-indent** (S114 note, kept in S130 as "left as is"). `add` wraps the `! A and B both touch PATH` line with no hang (`internal/tui/waves.go:511-515`, used at `:729-735`). The engine-conflict marker hangs its continuations four columns in (`:717-724`, `TestWavesConflictMarkerHangIndents`, `internal/tui/waves_test.go:1761`). Docs say the overlap lines "keep their existing indentation" (`docs/dashboard.md:2484-2485`); that sentence changes.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestRecentOutcomeGlyphsFollowTheASCIIOption` (`internal/tui/relayboard_test.go`): a harness as in `TestRecentSectionListsRunsEndedWithinTheHour` with four ended ledger runs within the hour: outcome `pass`; `fail`; `stopped`; `pass` with an engine run whose `Landed` is true and `RelayRun` is that ledger id. With `h.m.cfg.ASCII = true` the rows' `cells[0]` are exactly `+ pass`, `x fail`, `~ stopped`, `+ landed`, and no row text holds a byte >= 128. With `ASCII` false they are `✓ pass`, `✗ fail`, `~ stopped`, `✓ landed`. Red first: the ASCII case gets `✓ pass`.
- `TestRecentASCIIOutcomeKeepsItsColour` (`internal/tui/relayboard_test.go`): `NewTheme(false)`, `cfg.ASCII` true; `h.m.rowLine(row, false, nameW, 80)` for the pass row contains `th.Passed.Render("+ pass")` and for the fail row `th.Error.Render("x fail")`. Red first: the prefix check at `overview.go:948-953` sees no `✓`/`✗` and leaves both dim.
- `TestWavesOverlapLineHangIndents` (`internal/tui/waves_test.go`): `wavesHarness`, `l.overlap` with one pair `A`, `B` and `Shared` `testdata/golden/waves-sitting-held-80x24-mono.txt`, `twoWaveItems`, then `h.m.wavesBody(38).body`: the line whose plain text starts `  ! A and B both touch` is followed by at least one line, and every following overlap line starts with four spaces. Red first: the path line starts with two spaces (probe output above).
- Golden `TestGoldenRecentASCII` (`internal/tui/recent_test.go`): the Overview at 80x24, `NewTheme(true)`, `cfg.ASCII` true, the pass and fail runs above; writes `recent-80x24-ascii.txt`. Golden `TestGoldenWavesOverlapWrap` (`internal/tui/waves_test.go`): Waves at 80x24 mono with the long shared path; writes `waves-overlap-wrap-80x24-mono.txt`. Both are new files, so they fail first with "run go test ./internal/tui -update".

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the red tests above.
2. In `relayboard.go`, pick the pass and fail glyphs from `m.cfg.ASCII` (`+` and `x` in ASCII mode, `✓` and `✗` otherwise; adj 418). Keep `~ stopped` and the `, cleanup failed` suffix as they are.
3. In `rowLine` (`overview.go:946-953`), choose `th.Passed` and `th.Error` by the same glyph pair for the current `cfg.ASCII`, so the ASCII row keeps its colour.
4. In `waves.go:729-735`, wrap each overlap line as the conflict marker does: first line at `indent`, continuations at `indent+indent`, wrap width `max(width-2-2, 1)` (adj 419).
5. Run `go test ./internal/tui -update`. Expect only the two new goldens; any other changed golden is a fault to fix, not to keep (no existing ASCII golden shows a Recent row, and no existing Waves golden has an overlap path long enough to wrap).
6. Docs: `docs/dashboard.md:745-749` names the ASCII forms (`+ pass`, `x fail`, `+ landed`); replace the sentence at `:2485` with one that says overlap lines hang their continuations four columns in, like the conflict marker. Cite adj 418 and adj 419.
7. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet under `## Unreleased`, starting with the slice id.

UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- With an ASCII locale, every Recent row's outcome is '+ pass', 'x fail', '~ stopped' or '+ landed', and the Overview at 80x24 has no non-ASCII byte in a Recent row.
- With a UTF-8 locale, Recent rows are unchanged ('✓ pass', '✗ fail').
- The ASCII pass and fail outcomes keep the pass and error colours.
- A wrapped Waves overlap line hangs its continuation four columns in, as the engine-conflict marker does.
- `go vet ./...`
- `go test ./...`
- `gofmt -l .`
- `go test ./internal/tui -run 'TestRecentOutcomeGlyphsFollowTheASCIIOption|TestRecentASCIIOutcomeKeepsItsColour|TestWavesOverlapLineHangIndents|TestGoldenRecentASCII|TestGoldenWavesOverlapWrap' -count=1`
- `git diff --stat -- testdata/golden` lists only `recent-80x24-ascii.txt` and `waves-overlap-wrap-80x24-mono.txt`.
- `rg -n '"✓ |"✗ ' internal/tui/relayboard.go` shows the glyphs only in the non-ASCII branch.
- `slicer check`
- `adj lint`
- [HUMAN CHECK] At 80x24, start `LC_ALL=C ork` with a run that ended within the hour; press `tab` until the Overview shows; the Recent row reads `+ pass` (or `x fail`) in green (red), and the rules are `|` and `-`.
- [HUMAN CHECK] At 80x24 in a UTF-8 terminal, open Waves (`tab` to Waves), tick two items with `space` that share a long path; the `! A and B both touch` line wraps with its path four columns in.
